what: "Diego Gomez" (pseudonym): Payment halted, impossible forum demands
verbatim_snippet: "In August 2025, when Diego Gomez*, a Madrid-based Domestika instructor, checked his instructor dashboard, he found that the billion-dollar company had stopped paying him since July. The reason was his inactivity in the forum. He didn't understand why the online creative learning platform had halted his payments now. He had stopped replying to comments four years ago (his contract never stated it as a payment condition), and he was still getting paid until June 2025."

extra_fields.additional_quote: "One time, I had around 400,000 students enrolled. Replying to every student is humanly impossible."
